caption: A basic station is four hookups. AC mains feed a DC power supply — a 50-watt radio wants about 13.8 V at around 12 A. The microphone (voice plus push-to-talk) and the Morse key (keying) drive the transceiver. RF leaves through an SWR meter installed inline in the feed line — rated for the frequency and power being measured — and runs along the coax feed line to the antenna; on receive it comes back the same path.
spoken: a block diagram of a beginner station: mains power into a DC supply, the microphone and key into the transceiver, and RF out through an inline SWR meter and the coax feed line to the antenna
